paper: Best-of-3, three single agents in parallel (Table 1, Figure 3a)
description: 3 agents in parallel (best-of-3), each controlling all nine robots and changing one route per answer; the best improving answer of each round is accepted. Stops at a safe plan with F <= 153, after 5 rounds without improvement, or after 40 rounds.
stopping: 5 rounds without improvement (15 answers), safe plan with F<=153, or 40 rounds (120 answers)
